description: Test command injection using various shell operators. Tests ;, &&, ||, |, backtick, $(), and %0a (newline) operators with 'id' and 'whoami' as detection commands. Returns results array with operator, payload, status, output_snippet, likely_vulnerable. Side effects: Read-only detection commands (id, whoami). Sends ~14 requests.

base_value.description: Legitimate value for the parameter, e.g. '1'

operators.description: Injection operators to test. Default: all common operators.

url.description: Target URL that processes the parameter server-side

name: cmdi_test
